settings.heading: One great coffee. One indie roaster. Every month.
settings.subheading: Picked curates one specialty coffee from one outstanding independent roaster and delivers it straight to your letterbox. No choice paralysis. No compromise. Just discovery.

settings.heading: How Picked works
settings.subheading: Simple by design. Surprising by nature.

settings.title: We find the roaster
settings.body: Each month we partner with one outstanding independent roaster — someone doing something genuinely interesting with their sourcing, their roasting, or their story.

settings.title: They ship direct
settings.body: The featured roaster fulfils and ships their best seasonal offering directly to you. Fresh from the roastery, in letterbox-friendly packaging.

settings.title: You discover something new
settings.body: A new coffee. A new roaster. A new story. Every month, curated — so you don't have to choose.

settings.heading: Great coffee shouldn't be complicated to find.
settings.body:
Independent roasters are producing some of the most extraordinary coffees in the world. Finding them shouldn't require a spreadsheet, a subscription to every newsletter, or three hours on Instagram.

Picked does the searching so you don't have to. We curate one coffee from one roaster each month — the best they have to offer — and deliver it straight to your door.

No choice paralysis. No compromise. Just a great coffee and the story behind it.
settings.pull_quote: One great coffee. One story worth knowing.

settings.placeholder_text: We're finalising our first featured roaster partnership. Someone who takes their craft seriously, sources with care, and has a story worth telling. More soon.

settings.question: What exactly do I get?
settings.answer: Each month you receive 250g of specialty coffee from one featured independent roaster, delivered in letterbox-friendly flat-pack kraft packaging. Every subscriber gets the same coffee that month — it's curated, not customised.

settings.question: How does delivery work?
settings.answer: Your featured roaster ships directly to you each month — straight from the roastery, as fresh as possible. The packaging is designed to fit through a standard UK letterbox so you never need to be home.

settings.question: Can I choose my coffee or grind setting?
settings.answer: Not at launch. Picked is deliberately curated — one coffee, one roaster, for everyone that month. We'll add grind options in a future update based on subscriber feedback.

settings.question: What happens if I love a coffee and want more?
settings.answer: That's the best part. After delivery we'll introduce you directly to the roaster with a personal recommendation and a first-order offer. You'll be able to explore their full range and start a direct relationship with a roaster you actually like.

settings.question: Can I pause or cancel?
settings.answer: Yes — pause or cancel anytime from your account page. No minimum term, no cancellation fee.

settings.question: When do you launch?
settings.answer: We're building our first cohort now. Sign up to the waitlist and you'll be among the first to know — and first in line.

settings.heading: Be first in line.
settings.subheading: Join the waitlist and we'll let you know the moment we launch — plus you'll get a founding-member welcome.

settings.heading: Move up the queue.
settings.body: After you've confirmed your email, we'll send you a personal referral link. Every person you bring along moves you closer to the front of the queue.
